sources.title: Revisiting the Hybrid attack on sparse and ternary secret LWE
sources.publication_version: IACR ePrint 2019/1019 initial version; published at WAHC 2019
sources.locator: Sections 3 and 4; Algorithm 1 exhaustive-search hybrid and Section 3.2 meet-in-the-middle
hypotheses: dense LWE matrix with a sparse ternary secret
the guessed support/coordinate split and lattice preprocessing follow the paper's model
the paper's Gaussian-error and lattice-reduction success estimates hold
sources.implementation_mapping: sparse_secret_enum is an independent clean-room implementation of only the degenerate full-guess specialization of the Algorithm 1 exhaustive guessing component. For the 18 easy DS_BIN, DS_TER, and MIX_Q_SPARSE records, it traverses every support/value assignment admitted by the public exact-weight predicate, so the residual lattice stage disappears and correctness is independent of the matrix and error laws after public witness validation. This narrow paper-case mapping transfers no lattice preprocessing, Gaussian success assumption, runtime constant, or claim of fidelity to the complete hybrid algorithm.
sources.clean_room_attestation: No article text, pseudocode, or implementation file is copied or modified.
notice_obligations: Attribute Son and Cheon and link the CC BY 4.0 license when adapting paper material.
